notes: All four proposals implemented; deviations from the final conditions forced by the live services are documented in the module docstrings and docs/backlog/p1-G10-2.md: P239 FC1 - the TCU API answers 404 for the formatted CNPJ path, so the 14-character CNPJ is sent (parameter spelled seEmitirPDF=false as published); P240 - the CEIS/CNEP files publish full CPFs, which are masked at ingestion (***.456.789-**), S3 '403 AccessDenied' for a file not yet published is treated like a 404 in the walk-back (provider marker cgu_sanctions_bulk_not_published), the leniency zip has two members (Acordos + Efeitos), PEP is monthly (walk-back by month, stale after 40 days from publication), CSV decoded as cp1252 (superset of ISO-8859-1); names are scored with the shared P219 token-set Jaro-Winkler stand-in of batch p1-G10-1 (guarded import, local fallback); P236 - BrasilAPI and Minha Receita are one pipeline (same RFB dump), so the two-upstream not-found rule needs another pipeline; Querido Diario answers 400 for alphanumeric CNPJs (skipped as unsupported); OpenCNPJ/CNPJa/ReceitaWS parsers are coded and tested but not registered or called (terms pending); P252 - the homonym helper lives in the ibge_name_frequency module file (module batches cannot add core/namematch.py) and the always-on rule g10_homonym_name_match applies it to every name-only person match not already curved (sanctions_lists of p1-G10-1 marks homonym_applied); the opt-in module runs on person seeds only (it cannot see other modules' matches). Correlation rules: g10_homonym_name_match (downgrades, emits nothing) and g10_sanction_dedup (one listing = one finding of record, others INFO context_only, re-run safe). No LIGHT/ACTIVE variants exist for this batch.
